instruction: Save the currently viewed web pages in Chrome as PDF files to /home/user/Documents/WebPages, using the page title for each PDF name.

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting 2 Chrome tabs to PDF files in /home/user/Documents/WebPages directory. The evaluator extracts actual page titles from Chrome tabs using CDP and verifies that PDF filenames match or closely resemble these page titles, ensuring one-to-one correspondence between tabs and PDFs.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts actual page titles from Chrome tabs using CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) at runtime
Metric properly verifies PDF filenames match page titles using robust matching logic with normalization and word overlap (70% threshold)
One-to-one correspondence verification ensures each page title has a corresponding PDF file
Handles expected parameter correctly: directly accesses 'expected.get("count")' without incorrect 'rules' nesting
Comprehensive matching algorithm handles filename variations (special character removal, case-insensitivity, truncation)
Partial credit scoring provides granular feedback if only some PDFs match
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor enhancement: Consider adding explicit logging of which page titles matched which PDF files for debugging purposes
Edge case: Could add handling for duplicate page titles if multiple tabs have identical titles
